votes.evidence: src/rules/listing.ts:380 defines MEDIA = /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|svg|ttf|otf|woff2?|eot)$/i, meant for the 256 KiB exemption at line 394. Line 429 reuses it for the icon check: `!isStr(icon) || !MEDIA.test(icon)` -> 'is not an image file path'. An existing ./assets/icon.woff2 therefore passes both the path test and the file-exists test, and LST-014 reports nothing.
